plain: A king or ruler formally giving up the throne

webster.text: The act of abdicating; the abandoning of an office or trust, without a formal surrender, or before the usual or stated time of expiration.

example.quote: At the death, abdication, or deposition of a king, the primate calls the assembly of the electors to an open field near Warsaw.
example.cite: John Adams, A Defence of the Constitutions of Government of the United States of America, vol. 1 (London, 1787), ch. 3
